title: 官方数据与固定分组验证；历史轻量 OOF 诊断
hypothesis: 核验历史 OOF 后固定验证协议，建立后续优化可比较的错误分析；不评价新模型收益。
changes: 复用 EXP-001 v4 的已保存 OOF，不重新训练
补数据质量检查、固定划分与来源清单
补逐类、混淆、长度和 prompt 错误诊断

inputs.content_hashes_verified_scope: official train/test CSV and downloaded EXP-001 artifacts; external pools not read

config.near_duplicate_method: casefolded NFKC char 5-gram TF-IDF cosine; audit only

validation.scope: Independent recomputation of saved EXP-001 five-fold OOF; no new classifier training; not ATLAS20
validation.leakage_audit: PASS within audited historical pipeline: per-fold fitting; 0 prompt overlap; ID/label/fold/score alignment; does not certify external pretrained checkpoints

timing_note: Local audit main() took 2.704 seconds; excludes imports/download and historical classifier training. No GPU/API/Colab consumption.
conclusion: 固定 prompt-group-v1 并通过 5 项保护测试；独立复算历史 OOF BA 0.3122445936。官方 2699 行 / 150 prompt / 18 类未发现空值或完全重复；6 个外部文本来源仅登记，未逐行审计。不是新的榜单成绩。
limitations: 诊断结果只属于历史 TF-IDF/LinearSVC，不代表 ATLAS20；外部数据本阶段登记来源，原文逐行审计单独开展。
next_action: 按固定折审计公共生成池，再比较原池/清洗池/等量池；强模型收益后续单独确认。
